# Snakify

> > An interactive learning platform with 200+ exercises for teaching Python 3 and web design fundamentals through problem-solving.

Snakify is a comprehensive online coding education platform designed for beginners and students learning Python 3 and web development. The platform features structured lessons, interactive coding exercises, and a teacher dashboard for classroom management, making it suitable for Key Stage 3, AP Computer Science Principles, and CS1 curricula.

## Key Topics

- Python 3
- Control flow
- Data structures
- Functions and recursion
- String manipulation
- Lists and dictionaries
- Problem-solving
- Web development
- HTML5 and CSS
- JavaScript
- Bootstrap
- Interactive exercises
- Beginner tutorials
- Input/output
- Conditional logic

## Core Platform

- [Snakify Homepage](https://snakify.org/en): Python 3 and web design learning platform with 200+ interactive exercises
- [Teacher Dashboard](https://snakify.org/teacher): Teacher dashboard for managing Python 3 student progress and classroom assignments

## Python Fundamentals

- [Input, print and numbers](https://snakify.org/en/lessons/print_input_numbers): Python 3 lesson on input, print functions, numbers, and basic data types
- [Integer and float numbers](https://snakify.org/en/lessons/integer_float_numbers): Python 3 lesson covering integer/float arithmetic, operators, and type casting
- [Strings](https://snakify.org/en/lessons/strings_str): Python 3 tutorial on strings: slicing, indexing, and substring manipulation

## Control Flow and Loops

- [Conditions: if, then, else](https://snakify.org/en/lessons/if_then_else_conditions): Python 3 conditional statements lesson: if-then-else control flow and indentation
- [For loop with range](https://snakify.org/en/lessons/for_loop_range): Python 3 lesson on for loops, range function, and iteration control flow
- [While loop](https://snakify.org/en/lessons/while_loop): Python 3 lesson on while loops, loop control, break statements, and loop-else

## Data Structures

- [Lists](https://snakify.org/en/lessons/lists): Python 3 tutorial on lists: data structures, indexing, and sequence handling
- [Two-dimensional lists (arrays)](https://snakify.org/en/lessons/two_dimensional_lists_arrays): Python 3 tutorial on 2D arrays, nested lists, matrices, and loop iteration
- [Dictionaries](https://snakify.org/en/lessons/dictionaries_dicts): Python 3 tutorial on dictionaries: key-value pairs and associative arrays
- [Sets](https://snakify.org/en/lessons/sets): Python 3 lesson on sets data structure, operations, and immutable types

## Functions and Advanced Python

- [Functions and recursion](https://snakify.org/en/lessons/functions): Python 3 lesson on functions, recursion, parameters, returns, and code reusability

## Web Development

- [HTML5 and CSS](https://snakify.org/en/lessons/html5-and-css): Web development lesson on HTML5, CSS styling, and responsive design basics
- [JavaScript](https://snakify.org/en/lessons/javascript_js): JavaScript lesson with code examples and input/output programming tutorial
- [jQuery](https://snakify.org/en/lessons/jquery): jQuery tutorial on DOM manipulation, selectors, and web development
- [Responsive Design with Bootstrap](https://snakify.org/en/lessons/bootstrap): Bootstrap framework lesson on responsive design, grid systems, and mobile layout

## Practice Problems

- [Rook move](https://snakify.org/lessons/if_then_else_conditions/problems/rook_move): Chess-themed coding exercise on conditional logic and if-then-else statements
- [Least divisor](https://snakify.org/lessons/while_loop/problems/least_divisor): While loop coding exercise on number theory and divisor computation
- [Number of occurrences](https://snakify.org/lessons/dictionaries_dicts/problems/number_of_occurrences_before): Dictionary coding exercise on word counting and string manipulation
